text.description:
A charming one bedroom flat set within a modern purpose-built development with lift access, moments from the excellent amenities and transport links of Finchley Road. Offered with a 30% share*, the property offers ample living space with modern fixtures and fittings, stylish décor and wood floors.

The property is situated on the first floor and comprises a light and spacious reception room with access to a private balcony, semi open-plan kitchen, good-sized bedroom with built-in wardrobe - also with direct access to the balcony, contemporary bathroom and ample storage space.

Lithos Road is a pleasant residential street close to the shops, bars and restaurants of Finchley Road - including the O2 Centre, West Hampstead and Hampstead. Finchley Road Overground Station is only a 4 minute walk, and Finchley Road Underground Station (Jubilee and Metropolitan lines) an 8 minute walk, providing excellent links into the City and West End.

*There is the option to staircase ownership to 100% after 2 years.

Lease: Approx 107 years
Service Charge: Approx. £306.79 pcm
Sinking Fund: Approx. £68.94 pcm
Rent payable to CDS: £681.85 pcm
Ground Rent: £0
Council Tax Band: D
